title: Puckering Style Window (2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adds Puckering Styles and controls their properties. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Puckering Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Puckering Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438120178585) ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/54024056899481) Asset Library icon to open the default location for Puckering assets in the New Library Window. #### Add New Puckering Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click "+Add" in the Object Browser. Or add a Puckering file (.PTP) by dragging it to the Puckering tab or on the Puckering asset. → A Puckering style is added. #### Copy Puckering Style & Apply 1. Click Copy at the top right. → A Puckering style is duplicated. 2. Replace an existing Puckering Style and apply it. Or after selecting the Puckering first, click the Assign button to the right of the Puckering style. → The Puckering Style is replaced. #### Assign New Puckering Style 1. Select 1 or more existing Puckering assets in either the 2D window with the Edit Puckering Tool. 2. Right-click with the Puckering object selected to open the context menu. 3. When **Assign New Puckering** is executed, a new Puckering style (*.PTP) is created and automatically assigned to all selected Puckering objects.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for adding, copying, and assigning Puckering Styles within the Object Browser in version 2025.0 of the software.

title: Buttonhole Style Window (ver. 2025)
content: ### Objective Add and organize Buttonhole style and apply it to the Buttonholes in the scene. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole Style Tab (ver. 2025.0) ### ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438074257177) ### ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438070272665) Asset Library icon to open the default location for Buttonhole assets in the New Library Window. #### Add New Buttonhole Style & Apply 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click +Add at the top right. Or add a Buttonhole file by dragging it to the Buttonhole Style tab or on the Buttonhole asset. → A Buttonhole style is added. #### Copy Buttonhole Style & Apply 1. Click Copy at the top right. → A Buttonhole style is duplicated. 2. Replace an existing Buttonhole Style and apply it. Or after selecting a Buttonhole first, click the Assign Buttonhole to the right of the Buttonhole style. → The Buttonhole Style is replaced. #### Assign New Buttonhole Style 1. Select 1 or more existing Buttonholes in either the 3D window with the Select tool [Q] or in the 2D window with the select tool or Button/Buttonhole Select/move tool 2. While selected: go to the Buttonhole Style Tab 3. Select the Assign New Buttonhole option to generate and apply the New Buttonhole Style to all selected buttonhole assets. #### Buttonhole Item Context Menu Right-click a button in the location panel to rearrange the buttonhole list. **Menu** | **Description** ---|--- Delete | Deletes the selected Buttonhole style. ※Note: You can also delete them with the Delete buttonhole on the keyboard. A Buttonhole Style can only be deleted if there is no Buttonhole assigned to it. Delete All Unused Buttonholes | Removes unused Buttonholes from the Buttonhole list. Rename | Rename the Buttonhole style. Reset | Resets the properties of the Buttonhole style to the Default Buttonhole properties.

title: Trim Style Window (2025.0)
content: ### Objective Manage Trims as a shape or style in the Trim Window. It is possible to create, copy, apply, and set a style in the Trim list window. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Trim (Ver. 2025.0) Main Menu ▶ Object Browser ▶ Trim (Ver. 2025.0) ![ObjectBrowser-Trim.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438055259929) ### Operation #### Open Asset Library 1. Open the Asset Library tab in Location. 2. Select the Asset Library icon ![Asset Library.svg](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438055387417) to open the default location for Trim assets in the New Library Window. #### Add & Apply one or more Trim Styles 1\. Click Add at the top right to load a file( .trm, .obj, .fbx or .zip)to use as Trim. or Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ OBJ/FBX/USD and import a file, In the popup window, choose Object Type as Trim. or drag and drop a file (from Library or File Explorer) directly to the Trim Style Window or 3D window. **→** A Trim style is added. 2\. Drag the style from the Trim window to the 3D window, apply it, and Glue. #### Copy Trim Style & Apply 1. Click Copy at the top right in the Trim Style window. → A Trim style is duplicated. 2. Drag onto an existing Trim Style and apply it. Or after selecting the Trim Style first, click the Assign button to the right of the Trim style. → The Trim Style is replaced. #### Change Trim Styles 1\. Use the Select/Move tool to select a trim in the 3D window. 2\. Click the ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438070828441) Assign button to the right of the trim style name. Or drag and drop a Trim style onto the trim you've selected. **→** The selected Trim's style has been changed. 3\. Right-click on Trim to Delete / Delete all Unused Trims / Rename (Ver. 2025.0). ※ Note: The default file format for Trim in Marvelous Designer is .TRM file. Other supported file formats for importing Object Types as trim include .OBJ, .FBX, and .USD.
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for managing and applying trim styles in the Trim Window of Marvelous Designer, including instructions for creating, copying, and modifying trims.

title: Edit UV
content: ### Objective Check patterns' UVs before exporting garments and edit UV by shifting pattern locations in the UV Editor (ver2.3.0). ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ UV Editor (2025.0) Viewport Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ UV Editor (2025.0) Object Browser ▶ UV Editor (up to 2024.2) ![Captura](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438249522713) ### ### Operation #### Manual 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ UV Editor Object Browser ▶ UV Editor → A dotted rectangular guideline appears around all patterns in the UV Editor. 2. Click the icon image at the top-right corner of the guideline. → The guideline icon changes and it becomes available to adjust the UV area manually. → Guidelines display repetitively (ver2.4.0). 3. Select and shift patterns accordingly. #### Automatic If manually edited by clicking the icon to switch over to automatic. → The dotted rectangular guideline re-appears around all the patterns in the UV Editor.

title: Seam Taping
content: Create Seam Taping Extend Seam Taping Seam Taping Physical Properties ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## ## Create Seam Taping ### Objective Reinforce edges of Patterns to withstand from drooping down by gravity when Simulating. ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Segment Pattern ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Seam Taping ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Pattern Segment ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Seam Taping 2. Select a segment Pattern to reinforce. → The selected segment is now being highlighted in orange color. 3. Activate the Simulate. → The seam tape is now being applied to the selected segment and being reinforced. ※ Note: * Click-and-drag also allows applying seam tapes. * When the Seam Taping tool is active, the applied seam tape is color coded with arrows indicating the direction of applied seam tape (ver. 2024.2). ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438288340249) ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## Extend Seam Tapping (Ver. 2024.2) ### Objective Edit the seam tape extension output with options for overlapped and non-overlapped structures when 2 or more seam taping are intersected can be created. (Example: To create non-overlapped seam taping, first seam taping stop on the outline; second seam taping stop on the 1st seam taping) ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Extend ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Extend 2. Use the drop-down menu to select the stop position options: None, To Outline, and To Seam Taping. * * **Extend (None)** = Does not extend. * **Extend (To Outline)** = Extend to the pattern outline * **Extend (To Seam Taping)** = Extends to the seam taping area of ​​the intersected line. ※ Note: The arrow direction indicate the direction of seam taping. The end without arrow tip is the start of seam taping. And the end with arrow tip is the end of the seam taping. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438288569497) ![89308cd0-c743-465a-a7e8-153683d5631c](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438276828825) ## Seam Taping Physical Properties ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Seam Taping Select Seam Taping ▶ Property Editor ▶ Selected Line ▶ Physical Property ### Operation Physical Property | Fabric or Elastic ---|--- Preset | Select default presets from the dropdown menu: * Fusible (common) * Fusible (lapel) * Fusible (nonwoven) * Fusible (nonwoven_Small Parts) * Reinforcement (Bone Pocket) * Reinforcement (Under Collar) * Custom (see Detail) Use the folder icon to open the file explorer. Use the Save icon to save a custom made property. Detail | Depending on Fabric or Elastic options, you can adjust the additional Material simulation properties based on specific material property sliders.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on creating, extending, and managing seam taping in garment simulation to enhance pattern durability and accuracy.

title: Offset as Internal Line
content: ### Objective Input specific measurements to offset Patterns and segments as Internal Lines. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern ### Operation #### Offset as Internal Line 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Right-click on top of a Pattern and select Offset As Internal Line from the pop-up menu. → The Offset as Internal Line window appears. 3. Configure the settings as needed. Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be generated ---|--- Distance | Set the interval between each Internal Line. All | Set the distance of all segments to be the same. Individual (Ver. 2025.0) | Set the spacing for each line segment individually. Offset From (Ver. 2025.0) | When inputting individual distances, the individual line can be set as the previous or selected line. Reverse Direction | Change in the reverse direction of the selected segment. Both Sides (Ver. 2025.0) | Create internal lines in both directions based on the selected segment. Extend | to Pattern Outline | Extend to Pattern Outline. to Internal Line | Extend to Internal Line of the pattern. 4. Click OK. → Depending on the settings, the internal line/shape is created. → If it is a curve, the curve point is automatically optimized. #### Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Select the two Pattern outlines between where the Internal Lines are created. 3. Right click on the selected Pattern outline and select Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) → The Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 4. Adjust the options below as needed, then select OK. Name | Description ---|--- Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be created. Offset | Set the distance between each Internal Lines. Distance to Segment Edge | Set the distance from the Pattern outlines for the Internal Lines. Reverse Direction | Horizontally reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Opposite Segment | Vertically reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Straight Line | Create Internal Lines as straight lines. Perpendicular Direction | Create Internal Lines perpendicular to the selected Pattern outlines. → Internal Lines are created based on the above settings. ※ Note: * Using the same function, additional Internal Lines can be created between Internal Lines. * When the Pattern outlines or Internal Lines are divided in multiple segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to select them all.
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for offsetting patterns and segments as internal lines in a 2D design environment.

title: Edit Graphic Size (Property Editor)
content: ### Objective Use the Property Editor to resize, recolor adjust location and texture for all graphics. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Texture (2D) / Transform Graphic 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Texture (2D) /Transform Graphic ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline in Location 2. Select the graphic to be edited. → The selected graphic's properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Find the Graphic Transformation category. Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Enter a name for the graphic. Classification | Select one of the following graphic types: Embroidery, Logo, Print, or Wash (Jeanologia). Material | Configure the graphic's material, texture, color, and transparency. Graphic Configuration | Face | Place the graphic on the front, back, or both sides. Over Seamline (Ver. 10) | Place the graphic on the seam of patterns. ※Note: \- Graphic does not appear when the difference of the seam is over the allowable extent. \- Graphic may not be matching when it is placed over the curves. It this case, deactivate this option and adjust the graphic manually. Tile | Tile the graphic along the X or Y axis of a Pattern while maintaining its original size. ※ Note: The same option is available in the right-click pop-up menu. Graphic Transformation | Adjust the rotation angle, width, height, and Z-Offset(Ver. 10) of the graphic.
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide to using the Property Editor for resizing, recoloring, relocating, and texturing graphics within the 2D Pattern editing tool.

title: Steam
content: ### Objective Shrink or stretch Fabric partially like as using a steam iron. ### Location Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam ### Operation #### Steam Setting 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam → All Patterns are now being displayed in mesh. → The Steam Brush appears at the top-left corner of the 2D window. 2. Set the value as desired. Mode (v2026.0) | Add | Operates as a brush that adds Steam. ---|---|--- Remove | Sets Operates as a brush that removes Steam. Option | Shrinkage | Sets the shrinkage level. Size | Sets the size of the brush. Hardness | Sets the hardness of the steam. 3. Click and drag on desired area to steam. → According to the shrinkage, the selected area is now being displayed in light-blue or orange. 4. Activate the Simulate. #### Remove Steam 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Steam ▶ Steam 2D Toolbar ▶ Steam 2. Right-click on a pattern to remove steam, and select either Remove Steam on Selected Pattern or Remove All Steam. → The steam is now being deleted accordingly. ※ Note: It can also be removed from the same right-click pop-up menu with Edit Pattern or Transform Pattern tools.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to effectively use the steam feature to shrink or stretch fabric patterns within the software.

title: Set Fabric Textures
content: ### Objective Represents the pattern or texture of the fabric. ### Location Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab ### Operation 1. Click the menu at the indicated location. 2. Select a fabric item. → Fabric properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Set the basic material by referring to the table below. #### PBR (Default) Option | Description ---|--- Texture Repeat Type (Ver. 10) / Texture Mapping (Ver. 11) | Repeat | Repeatedly display the texture on the pattern. Unified Map | Display the texture based on the pattern layout of the UV map. [Repeat UV Settings] * Repeat U: Size the texture based on U direction. * Repeat V: Size the texture based on V direction. The number 1 means that the texture is repeated once between 0-1 of the UV map. Type | Set the appropriate Material Type. ※Note: If garment is created in Marvelous Designer or Downloaded from CONNECT, the fabric type may display as * (Read-only) Fabric Type with the same name in Marvelous Designer. However, since there is no render engine in Marvelous Designer, the fabric display in 3D window will not be accurate. Base Color (ver. 2025.0) | Color | Select your chosen color from the color wheel or leave as (None) Base Color Map | Recolor | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Desaturate | It desaturates the color of the graphics. Set the Shadow Intensity and Shadow Brightness. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of solid fabric to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47358364190105) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Texture | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder ※Note: Click both back and side tabs and deactivate 'Use Same Materials as Front' to apply different materials to other faces of the pattern. Remove Texture Color | Remove the default color to apply other colors while retaining the pattern or texture. Normal Map | Apply Normal Map image to express uneven texture more realistically. Automatic | When a texture is applied, Normal Map is generated by adjusting the Intensity. Higher intensity makes the embossed detail raised off the surface, the lower intensity makes the details lower than the surface. Manual | Click the explore or apply the Normal Map image from the Library/Folder ※Note: Use the normal map image made with the exclusive tool to achieve an accurate normal effect. Also, add a normal map that is different with texture in order to create an extra pattern of surface. Displacement Map (ver.11) | Express thickness or bumpiness of fabrics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. ※ Note: * Increase the image resolution and apply the Gaussian Blur effect to express the texture smoothly. * Displacement map's minimum particle distance value is now 0.01 mm to allow for greater mesh density for displacement map (Ver. 2024.1) Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Color | Express each of the fabrics in various colorways Opacity | Adjust Opacity to create sheer fabric. ※Note: When you apply opacity to texture, change Garment Rendering Style as Thick Textured Surface. Alpha Map (ver. 10) | Express level of transparency using a grayscale image map RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Roughness | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or fabric is and vice-versa. Metalness (ver. 10) | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map (ver. 10) | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. ※Note: * When working with Metalness Map, control Roughness Intensity and Reflection Intensity level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) * For the non-metallic areas(matte), assign the same metalness map to Roughness Map, and turn on Invert. #### Substance (ver. 10) Set the file format as Substance at the right menu of Material, you can use SBSAR file of Substance which is the main application of physical based rendering. To get a better rendering result for substance materials, enable High-Quality Render on 3D window. Properties | Description ---|--- Substance File | Import SBSAR file by clicking 'Explore' or, download SBSAR file by clicking 'Go to Substance Source'. * SBSAR file can be imported by Object Browser> Right-click on Fabric item. Preset | Choose the preset of SBSAR. Resolution | Adjust the image resolution of SBSAR. Custom Properties | Edit the properties of SBSAR. ※Note: Custom Properties are different depending on the property of the file. Refer to the [Substance Manual](https://docs.substance3d.com/home) for more detailed information. ※ Note: * Clicking on a Fabric from the Fabric List is going to highlight the Patterns where the Fabric is being applied to, in the 3D/2D window. * Clicking on a Pattern in the 3D or 2D window is going to highlight the Fabric where it is being applied to, in the Object Browser ▶ Fabric Tab.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users in selecting and customizing fabric patterns and textures within the software, ensuring accurate material representation and rendering in their designs.

content_description: The purpose of this web page is to guide users in viewing and editing various components, such as scenes and fabric styles, within both 3D and 2D windows using the Object Browser feature.

content: ## **3D Render Style** **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/49955307088537)Quality Render (3D Window)**(Ver. 10) * The render quality of the 3D Window is improved. * Location: Icon in the 3D Window ▶ Quality Render (3D Window) ※ Note: It is recommended to turn on/off the Quality Render option as needed since it is slower than the regular render. **![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/49955331792153)Schematic Render (Alt+0)**(Ver. 2025.0) * Render 3D Garments into schematic format. ## title: Graphic Style Properties (Ver. 2025.0)
content: Graphic Style Properties Material PBR (Default) Individual Graphic Properties Options ## ## Graphic Style Properties ### Location Main Menu ▶Materials ▶ Graphics ### Objective Set the graphic properties. ### Location 2D Toolbar ▶ Transform Graphic ### Operation #### Properties Graphic Style 1. Object Browser ▶ Click a graphic style in the Graphic Tab → The selected graphic's properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Set the properties of the Graphic Style Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name/Item No. | Enter a name or an item number of the graphic. Material | Configure the graphic's material, texture, color, and transparency. Graphic Configuration | Face | Place the graphic on the front, back, or both sides. Over Seamline (ver MD10) | Place the graphic on the seam of patterns. ※Note: \- Graphic does not appear when the difference of the seam is over the allowable extent. \- Graphic may not match when it is placed over the curves. In this case, deactivate this option and adjust the graphic manually. Tile | Tile the graphic along the X or Y axis of a Pattern while maintaining its original size. ※ Note: The same option is available in the right-click pop-up menu. Graphic Transformation | Adjust the rotation angle, width, height, and Z-Offset(ver MD10) of the graphic. ## Material PBR (Default) Edit each property for the Front / Back / Side of the mesh. Option | Description ---|--- Type | Select the desired Material Type. Fabric_Matte, Fabric_Shiny, Fabric_Silk/Satin, Fabric_Velvet, Fur_Strand, Leather, Metal, Plastic Base Color Map | Color | Select a color by selecting the Square or using color codes. Click the Explore button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) and apply a Graphic image from Library/Folder. Click the Trash can icon to delete the graphic image from the scene. Recolor | Desaturate | Desaturate the entire Base Color Map to remove color and convert it into grayscale or black and white. Switch | Easily and quickly switch the color of a solid Graphic to a new one without losing the accuracy of the chosen color. ![Switch Color.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193814553) ※Note: For consistent results, the Base Color Map should contain 1 color. If the Base Color Map contains multiple colors, users may experience unexpected or unintended results. Normal Map | Texture image that stores surface normal information in an RBG image. Use the same map as the Fabric ON / OFF toggle (this turns off the intensity slider) Intensity | When a texture or graphic is applied, a Normal Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Adjust the Intensity with the slider. Higher intensity results in more pronounced details, and a lower intensity makes the details lower to the surface. Open | Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) to select a custom Normal map image. After you open an image, Transformation settings for Angle, Width, Height, and Aspect Ratio are enabled. \+ Add Another App | Additional Application can be registered to open an assigned texture. Once registered, the application will be listed and remain available for future use. Open With Another App | Open the image in another App (for example, Photoshop) Displacement Map | Express the thickness or bumpiness of Graphics or textures. As displacement maps are grey-scaled, their height is determined by the level of darkness of the grey color. Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) to select a custom Displacement map image. When a texture or graphic is applied, a Displacement Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Use the same map as the Fabric ON / OFF toggle Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. ※ Note: As more memory is used for lower Particle Distance, it is recommended not to set the Particle Distance below 1 for a wide area. Keep Continuity | Extend the graphic to the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. \+ Add Another App. | Additional Application can be registered to open an assigned texture. Once registered, the application will be listed and remain available for future use. Open With Another App. | Open the image in another App (for example, Photoshop) Opacity | Express level of transparency using a grayscale image map. Opacity | Adjust Opacity level from 0-100. Opacity Map | Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) to selcet a custom Opacity map image. When a texture or graphic is applied, a Opacity Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Use the same map as Fabric ON / OFF toggle Mode | RBG | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Reflection | Use same map as Fabric ON / OFF toggle Roughness | Intensity | Edit Graphic gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness. Adjust from 0- 50 (default) - 100 Map | Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) to select a custom Normal map image. When a texture or graphic is applied, a Roughness Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. the slider's range is 0-100 with default being 50 Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the Graphic. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below Ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | Greater the Reflection Intensity value is, more reflective than the material or Graphic is and vice-versa. Metalness | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. ※Note: When working with the Metalness Map, control the Roughness Intensity and Reflection Intensity level that are suitable for the metallic texture. (e.g. Roughness Intensity 10, Reflection Intensity 90) Metalness Map | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic. Click the Explore Button ( ![Explore Button.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438193601177) ) to select a custom Metalness map image. When a texture or graphic is applied, a Metalness Map may be generated by clicking the Generate icon. (![GenerateButton.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438222925721) ) Graphic Transformation | Adjust the size of the imported graphic image Width (mm) | You can change the dimensions by exact measurements or % values Height (mm) | You can change the dimensions by exact measurements or % values Lock Aspect ratio | Lock the aspect ratio of the graphic so the ratio remains consistent during size changes ## ## Individual Graphic Properties **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Graphic Configuration | Face | Place the graphic on the front, back, or both sides. Tile | Repeat the graphic in its original size along the X-axis, Y-axis, or across the entire pattern. Over Seamline | Place the graphic on the seam of patterns. **※Note:** - Graphic does not appear when the difference of the seam is over the allowable extent. \- Graphic may not be matching when it is placed over the curves. It this case, deactivate this option and adjust the graphic manually. \- Graphics are also created for patterns sewn in two layers, such as pockets. Tolerance (mm) | Allowance for differences between patterns. Graphic Transformation | Adjust the rotation angle and Z-offset of graphic. 2D Measurements | Click the desired measurement option to check the position within the 2D pattern in dimensions. To Center: Toggle on/off the options for (Left, Right, Up, Down) To Outline: Toggle on/off the options for (Left, Right, Up, Down) ## ## Options 1. Click the tool/menu in Location. 2. Right click on the 2D graphic. → A right-click popup menu appears. 3. Apply options as needed. **Options** | **Descriptions** ---|--- Delete | Delete the selected graphic. Copy/ Paste | Copy, Paste, and Mirror Paste the selected graphic. Order (2D) | Set the placement order of the graphic. Rotate | Set the rotation angle of the graphic. Tile | Repeat the graphic in its original size along the X-axis, Y-axis, or across the entire pattern. Revert to Original Size | Restore the transformed graphic to its original size. Filip | Flip the graphic horizontally or vertically. Zoom to selected | Zoom / Fill 2D window with the selected Graphic image in the scene.
content_description: This web page provides comprehensive guidance on configuring graphic style properties and materials in a design application, enabling users to customize and manipulate graphics efficiently within their projects.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Slider and Stopper Properties
content: ### Objective Set and modify the Zipper Slider, puller and Stopper properties. ※ Note: The Puller, Slider, and Stopper of the zipper have been separated so that each can be individually selected and edited. (Ver. 2025.0). ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ### Operation * Select the tool indicated in Location. * Select a Zipper or Stopper created on a 3D Garment and modify its properties: Option | Description ---|--- Name | Customize the name of the zipper. Type (Ver. 2025.0) | One Way | One slider and puller is shown. Two Way | Two sliders and pullers are shown which can be moved in opposite directions. Direction (Ver. 2025.0) | Direction can be configured when the type is set to Two Way. Bottom to Bottom | Slider and Puller will be positioned near the Stopper, at the end of the zipper. Head to Head | Slider and Puller will be positioned of the original position. Shape | Slider | Select a shape for the slider. Puller | Select a shape for the puller. Stopper | Select the Stopper type (Open / Closed End) and then select shapes for Top and Bottom. (ver MD10) ※ Note: A selection of Bottom shapes is configured based on the shape of the Stopper. Specification | Gauge | Select the size of the Slider by Gauge or percentage. Weight (g) | Assign the weight of the slider. (Ver 4.2) Fasten Zipper | Reverse Zip Direction | Select the zip direction. The slider is relocated based on the option. Move to Opposite Side | Select a side of the zipper tape where the slider will locate when the zipper is open. Material | Configure the Slider's Type, Texture, Color, and Opacity. ※ Note: Uncheck Use Same Material as Slider after selecting the Puller or Stopper tab to assign material separately. (Ver. 10) Polygon Optimization (Ver. 2024.0) | Count | Set the number of polygons. Plane | This is applied in the form of a texture when the Plane is activated. Count cannot be set on Plane activation. ※ Note: * Adjust the weight of the Slider
content_description: This web page provides detailed instructions for selecting and customizing the properties of zippers, pullers, and stoppers in 3D garment design, allowing for individual adjustments to enhance design flexibility.

title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Topstitch Corner Type
content: ### Objective Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. ※ Note: If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. ### Location 2D Pattern Window ▶ Edit Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Corner ### Operation #### Curved Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. #### Right Angled Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Right Angled ▶ On → The selected topstitch is now being curved at a right angle. #### Topstitching Smooth Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Smooth ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. Set this to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken.
content_description: This webpage provides step-by-step instructions for adjusting topstitch corner types in the 2D Pattern Window to ensure smoother stitch transitions at corners.

title: Seamline Property (ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Adjust Seamline properties such as line types, tension, sublayers, topstitch, puckering, and 3D Seamline Normal Maps to render a realistic Garment. ### ### Location Main Menu ▶ Sewing ▶ Edit Sewing (B) 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Sewing (B) ### Operation 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Click on any point or segment of the Sewing Line to display the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Seam | Open | Open a Sewing Style Preset File (*.ssp). Save | The current properties can be saved as a Sewing Style Preset File (.ssp) type file. Information | Name | Set the name of the currently selected sewing line. Sewing Line Type | Turned (Off) | Fold Strength | The intensity of the fold is able to be set by adjusting the value of Fold Strength. The higher the value, the closer the fold is to the set angle. When a jacket and its lining are sewn together, the sewn area inflates due to the default sewing angle and intensity values. In this case, set the Fold Strength to 0 to flatten the sewn boundaries. Fold Angle | 180° represents a flat state. The internal line is folded towards the front of the pattern as the fold angle is closer to 0˚ and is folded into the back of the pattern as the angle is closer to 360˚. Turned (On) | Sew two layers of pattern flatly. The Fold Strength and Fold Angle settings cannot be adjusted. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438049347737) Tension | When the 3D garment is expressed as being stretched more than the actual garment, adjust the Tension of Sewing Line. Same as the actual real life concept, Tension is applied based on the short or long side with the Ease and Stretch options. Sewing Line Type | Ease | When the seam lengths differ, this type adds a slight allowance, resulting in a relatively soft sewing tension. Stretch | When the seam lengths differ, this type does not add any allowance, resulting in a more precise and higher sewing tension. Strength | Increase or decrease the strength of the sewing tension by entering the value. The result may vary depending on the Strength even with the same Ratio value. Ratio | Adjust the sewing tension's ratio to express varying drape effects by different sewing methods. Set Sublayer | Assign orders to the Sewing Lines on a Pattern that folds on itself such as seam allowances and pleats, to increase simulation stability. Reverse Direction | Swap the order of the Sewing Line and the Sewed Line. Sublayer | Decide which side of the fabric is attached to the fixed Sewing Line, Back or Front. Topstitch | Name | Rename the Topstitch. Topstitch Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | When the start or end point of a Topstitch does not reach or sticks out of the Pattern outline, extend it to fit to the Pattern. Corner | Curved | Set the Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. Right Angled | Set the Topstitch to be a right angle in the corner of the pattern. Smooth | Set it to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken. Offset | Set the Z Offset of the Topstitch. Placement | Seam A | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Topstitch will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Topstitch will be shown on both sides. Puckering | Name | Rename the Puckering. Puckering Property | Change the style of the selected Topstitch. Extend | Extend the start/endpoint of the puckering to the 2D pattern outline. Offset | Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the puckering and the pattern outline. Include the Puckering Width in Offset or not if needed. Z Offset (mm) | Adjust the distance between the Z-axis and a pattern piece. Placement | Seam A | Puckering will be shown only on Seam A. Seam B | Puckering will be shown only on Seam B. Seam Both | Puckering will be shown on both sides. 3D Seamline | Plain Seam | Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Directional | Placement | Select Seam A or Seam B for the placement of the seamline. Normal Map | Select an image to be used as the Normal Map. Intensity | Adjust the intensity of the Normal Map applied to the seamline. Thickness (mm) | Adjust the thickness of the Normal Map applied to the seamline.
content_description: This webpage provides comprehensive tools and options for adjusting seamline properties, enabling realistic garment rendering through detailed customization of sewing styles, including tension, sublayers, topstitching, and puckering.

title: ZIPPER: Zipper Tape Properties
content: ### Objective Modify the Zipper tape properties. ### ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶ Select/Move ▶ Zipper Tape (Click On Zipper Tape)▶ Property Editor → The properties of the selected Zipper Tape appear in the Property Editor. 2. Modify the Zipper Tape properties based on the available options below: **Properties** | **Description** ---|--- Name | Rename the Zipper Tape. Line Length | Edit the length of the Zipper teeth. Preset (ver. 2025.0) | Set the preset of the Zipper from Custom, Plastic_01, Plastic_02, Metal, Nylon, Reverse_Nylon, Invisible. Texture (ver. 2025.0) | Set the Teeth type to Texture or OBJ. Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Opacity | Opacity | Adjust the opacity level from 0 to 100. Opacity Map | RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Reflection | Roughness | Dropdown menu | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness slider Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. title: Compatible File Format
content: ### File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, in addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar USD | *.usd | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. Serves as a universal interchange format for 3D content across various applications and platforms. For more information, please see the [USD file compatibility page.](USD%20file%20Compatibility) USDZ (ver. 2025.0) | *.usdz | X | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, Camera, and Scene Layout information. It is a compressed package format that combines all 3D assets into a single file. Primarily used for AR/VR applications and interactive 3D content. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | *.sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive overview of supported file formats for importing and exporting 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, detailing their specific contents and compatibility for enhanced workflow efficiency.

title: Can I cancel my subscription?
content: #### _*** The annual license is only a one-time purchase license, and it won't be auto-renewed.**_ ## **[Personal Monthly License Holder]** Yes, if you're using a recurring subscription license, you can cancel your recurring subscription on [My account > License page. ](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license)(Click "Stop Subscription") ![mceclip0 \(2\).png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47448309723161) You can either choose**"Cancel Subscription"** or **"Pause Subscription"** of up to 6 months. _* Even if you cancel your subscription, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the license expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ _* For annual license subscribers, the "Stop Subscription" button is not visible because the license does not renew automatically._ ## **[Personal Trial License Holder]** ![trial.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438478664473) You can cancel the trial by clicking the**Cancel Trial** button. No charges will be applied after the trial expires. _* Even if you cancel your Trial, you can continue using it for the remaining period until the trial expires under the "**cancel scheduled** " status. Once the license expires, it will be completely canceled, and no additional charges will be incurred._ #### **Personal License Status Details:** ✅ Active Your license is currently active, and payments are being processed as expected. You have full access to Marvelous Designer. ⏳ Pause Scheduled Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a pause has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled pause date. 🚫 Paused Your license remains active, but payments have been stopped, and Marvelous Designer is no longer accessible. 📅 Cancel Scheduled Your license is active, and payments are being processed, but a cancellation has been scheduled. You can continue using Marvelous Designer until the scheduled cancellation date. **Would you like to learn more about subscription pause?** 📖 View the manual: 🔗 [Can I pause my subscription?](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358159780505) * * * ## **[Enterprise Network Online Monthly License Holder]** Per cancellation to **Enterprise Network Online** Monthly plan, please follow the steps below. * [Log in ](https://marvelousdesigner.com/en/member/signin)with your **Company ID** on our website * Go to [License Account Admin page](https://marvelousdesigner.com/en/teamconsole) * Find the License ID that has the Network Online Monthly plan and click ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438506845465) * Cancel the subscription at Active License list ![cancel_ent.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47448309727513) **Note** * You will be able to access your license until the current subscription date, and you can re-subscribe at any time after the license expiration. * Please note cancellation of subscription after the renewal is non-refundable.
content_description: This web page provides essential information on managing your Marvelous Designer license, including options for cancelling or pausing subscriptions for both personal and enterprise users.
